title: Investigating Business in a Competitive Environment

questions.question: Assess two factors that influence price elasticity of demand (PED) in a competitive retail market.
questions.modelAnswer: Availability of close substitutes and brand loyalty heavily dictate PED. If many substitutes exist, demand is price elastic; strong brand loyalty reduces elasticity.
questions.reasoning: Award 2 marks for knowledge of PED influencers, 2 marks for contextual retail application, and 4 marks for analytical reasoning.
